playground.heroDesc: I craft immersive audio experiences, sound effects, and music for games and audiovisual media. Based in Curitiba, Brazil.
playground.aboutDesc: Sound designer, Foley artist, and Composer with a Bachelor's degree in Music from UFPR. I specialize in building immersive audio landscapes with creative depth and technical precision.
playground.servicesDesc: Core audio production services for games, films, and interactive media.
playground.postsDesc: Read articles and insights on sound design and music.
playground.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about working with me on audio and music productions.
playground.faq1_a: I specialize in sound design, Foley art, and music composition for games, audiovisual projects, and branding. I provide end-to-end audio production, including recording, mixing, and mastering.
playground.faq2_q: How do you approach a new project?
playground.faq2_a: My process starts with a deep dive into the creative vision. I work closely with developers and directors to understand the aesthetic goals, then iterate on sonic concepts through prototypes and technical implementation in tools like Reaper and Pro Tools.
playground.faq3_q: What formats do you deliver in?
playground.faq3_a: I deliver high-quality WAV, AIFF, or specialized assets prepared for middleware implementation (e.g. FMOD, Wwise) and game engine integration.
playground.faq4_q: What gear and software do you use?
playground.faq4_a: I primarily work with Reaper and Pro Tools for DAW work, and DaVinci Resolve for video sync. My studio is equipped with professional-grade microphones and monitoring systems ensuring the highest fidelity.
playground.ctaDesc: I'm currently available for freelance projects and collaboration. Let's work together to bring your vision to life.

page_about.title: About
page_about.description: Sound designer, Foley artist, and Composer with a Bachelor's degree in Music.
page_about.heading: About Me
page_about.bioP1: Hi, I'm Marcelo Caldart Filho, a Sound Designer and Musician based in Curitiba, Brazil. For the past years, I've been immersed in the world of audio creation, focusing on building experiences that are not just functional, but genuinely immersive and engaging for players and viewers.
page_about.bioP2: My approach blends creative strategy with technical expertise, transforming concepts into purposeful sonic experiences. Whether I'm crafting pixel-perfect sound effects or composing atmospheric music, my focus is always on creating value for the project and its audience.
page_about.philosophyP1: My work is rooted in creativity and problem-solving. I believe great sound design starts with understanding the 'why' – the project's needs, motivations, and emotional core. I use specialized tools like Reaper and Pro Tools to ensure the sonic solutions I build are truly effective.
page_about.philosophyP2: I strive to create audio that feels effortless, where functionality and beauty work hand-in-hand. Whether it is a subtle ambient track or an action-packed Foley sequence, my focus is on delivering high-quality assets ready for integration.
page_about.beyondP1: When I'm not designing sounds or composing music, you might find me exploring Curitiba's cultural scene or contributing to creative projects.
